name: Warm Bavarian Soft Pretzel & Smooth Cheese Dip
whyItWorks: Soft Bavarian pretzels are made from refined white flour and yeast - much safer than hard, jagged pretzel sticks or corn tortilla chips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake a frozen soft pretzel in the toaster oven at 375F for 4-5 minutes (crisp outside, pillow-soft inside, never microwave-rubbery). Dip in warm melted cheddar.
